purpose: 《恁祖媽今年18》第一季第 1–60 集共用的 look、角色外貌（英文，給圖與影片模型）、聲音、路人、場景、道具與長明燈的提示詞。每集 video.json 從這裡照抄用到的角色（id、name、appearance、voice；換裝用 shot_looks），不要各自改寫，避免換臉。寫法、時間、帳與接點照同目錄 s1-bible-e001-e060.md。
owner_notes: 站主 2026-10-28（plan.json）：每集 90–180 秒、篇章最後一集至少 120 秒；每集 3–5 個鉤子。
plan.json production.voice：國語；沈月棠是「少女嗓、老人家語氣」，第 1 集前站主試聽核定。2026-11-06 主對話轉達已暫定：十八歲 Kore、九十六歲另開角色 Gacrux。
setting.json advertiser_safety 與 glamour：不露胸背、不濕身、鏡頭不停在身體部位；未成年裙長過膝；美在臉、眼神、身段與動作；她的反差是十八歲的臉配老人家的手勢。
票 2026-10-28 Notes（2026-11-05 定案）：今年二〇二六（民國一一五年）；大火民國三十七年（一九四八）；月棠 96、作甫 1922–1948、遠山 98、玉琴 78（作甫的女兒）、福伯 88。
規格 2026-11-05（storyboard-shot-spec.md）：台詞有頭有尾、一句 10–24 字；說話的人在畫面上嘴要動，畫外的台詞配閉嘴的反應鏡。
2026-11-06 主對話轉達、已暫定：畫面 16:9；CC 軟字幕不燒錄；不改 season-01.json，改字照 bible〈與細綱不同處〉。
沒有系統、沒有面板：長明燈的光是全劇唯一的「特效」，老化只用化妝與光（setting.json visual_bible）。
站主 2026-11-06（試鏡後的變更單，票 2026-11-06-tai-nainai-change-ageing-opening）：老化記號放大到一眼看得到——細紋＝右手背一片細細的老人紋、淡一線＝一道看得見的淺紋、一縷白髮＝右鬢一指寬的明顯白髮；分鏡的中文用詞不改，畫面照這裡與 bible〈燈帳與她的樣子〉。

look.style: photorealistic live-action modern Taiwanese urban family drama, film still, natural cinematic light, realistic skin and fabric texture, soft flattering beauty light on faces, shallow depth of field; the old Shen house in warm amber wood and candlelight, the Shengtong tower in cold blue glass, the small pharmacy in warm white fluorescent light
look.negative: cartoon, anime, illustration, plastic CG look, text, letters, Chinese characters, readable signs, subtitles, watermark, logo, brand names, license plates, extra fingers, deformed hands, blood, gore, nudity, cleavage, low neckline, bare back, see-through clothing, short skirt, wet clothes, fantasy glow effects, sparkles
look.motion: Natural, realistic human motion; one clear action per clip; faces, clothes and props stay the same; her elderly manners stay slow and steady; no morphing, no cuts

lamp.rule: 長明燈是全劇唯一的「特效」：亮時溫暖的橘金色，暗時帶灰的黃。每鏡照 bible〈燈帳〉的分數，把對應的句子寫進 prompt。第一季不拍油面高低、不翻燈座底面、不拍燈座頂面特寫。

levels.1: a bean-sized dim greyish-yellow flame inside the glass chimney, its light barely reaching beyond the chimney
levels.3: a knuckle-high steady warm orange-gold flame, its light reaching across the altar table top
levels.4: a warm orange-gold flame about one and a half knuckles high, its light reaching the lowest row of drawers of the medicine cabinet
levels.5: a two-knuckle-high warm orange-gold flame lighting the lower half of the medicine cabinet and glinting on the bronze mirror
levels.6: a tall warm orange-gold flame whose light spills through the lattice doors onto the stone steps outside
levels.7: a tall bright warm orange-gold flame filling the whole ancestral hall with warm light
levels.8: a very bright warm orange-gold flame whose light reaches across the courtyard to the dining room's back windows
levels.9: a sudden burst of bright warm orange-gold lamplight flooding the whole hall out to the doorway and lighting the old people sitting there

lamp.dim: the flame flickers once, shrinks one step and turns greyish-yellow
lamp.brighten: the flame grows steadily one step taller and warmer
